title: Universal probability bounds for partial Latin squares
summary: This paper studies the probability of substructures occurring in random Latin squares. Our main result states that if $α,β>0$ are such that $2α+β<1$, then there are positive constants $δ= δ(α, β)$ and $Δ= Δ(α, β)$ such that if $P$ is a partial Latin square of order $n$ with $k = k(n)$ non-empty cells occupying at most $αn$ rows and $βn$ columns, the probability that a random Latin square of order $n$ contains $P$ lies between $(δ/n)^k$ and $(Δ/n)^k$.
